;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2018 Vienna stabbing]]
**Two connected stabbings occurred in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]]: three people were seriously injured outside a [[Japan]]ese restaurant, and one man in a later stabbing. The perpetrator was arrested. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/world/europe/austria-stabbings-latest-updates-vienna-attack-family-knife-a8245171.html (''The Independent'')]
;Arts and culture
*[[Paula (1876 barque)#Message in a bottle find|A message in a bottle]] found in [[Australia]] is confirmed to have been adrift for [[Message in a bottle#Long-duration events|almost 132 years]], making it reportedly the oldest known [[message in a bottle]]. [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2018-03-06/oldest-known-message-in-a-bottle-found-on-wa-beach/9518632 (ABC Online)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[List of accidents and incidents involving helicopters|Accidents and incidents involving helicopters]]
**A [[Border Service of the Federal Security Service of the Russian Federation|Russian Border Guard Service]] [[Mil Mi-8]] crashes in [[Chechnya]], killing at least eight people. [http://tass.com/world/993173 (TASS)]
*[[March 6–8, 2018 nor'easter]]
**A second winter storm occurs in the [[East Coast of the United States|East Coast]] of the [[United States]], only a few days after [[March 1–3, 2018 nor'easter|another storm]]. [https://weather.com/storms/winter/news/2018-03-07-winter-storm-quinn-noreaster-snow-wind-forecast (The Weather Company)]

;International relations
*[[Australia–East Timor relations]]
**[[Australia]] and [[East Timor]] sign a [[treaty]] for a permanent maritime border in the [[Timor Sea]], ending a decade-long dispute over rights to the sea's rich oil and gas reserves. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-australia-43296488 (BBC)]

;Law and crime
*[[Hate crime in the United Kingdom]]
**[[Paul Golding]] and [[Jayda Fransen]], leader and deputy of the [[United Kingdom|British]] far-right organization [[Britain First]], are convicted of [[Hate crime#United Kingdom|hate crimes]] for posting things deemed offensive online. Golding is sentenced to 36 weeks in prison and Fransen to 18 weeks in prison for promoting [[Islamophobia|Islamophobic]] activities and [[Harassment in the United Kingdom|harassment]]. [https://www.independent.co.uk/news/uk/crime/paul-golding-jayda-fransen-britain-first-leaders-guilty-religious-muslim-hate-crime-a8244161.html (''The Independent'')] [https://www.bbc.com/news/uk-england-43320121 (BBC)]
*[[Crime in the United States]]
**Former [[United States]] [[United States Department of Justice|Department of Justice]] attorney Jeffrey Wertkin is sentenced to 2½ years in prison for what prosecutors called the DoJ's "most serious" example of [[Corruption#Government/public sector|public corruption]], which involved stealing more than 40 [[whistleblower]] fraud cases in 2016 with intentions to sell the secret information to companies under federal investigation. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/local/public-safety/ex-justice-dept-lawyer-caught-in-most-serious-internal-corruption-case-in-recent-memory/2018/03/08/560071e2-2262-11e8-86f6-54bfff693d2b_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Politics and elections
*Aftermath of the [[Stoneman Douglas High School shooting]]
**[[Florida]]'s [[Florida House of Representatives|House of Representatives]] votes 67–50 to approve a gun and school safety bill that would raise the age to buy firearms from 18 to 21, sending the bill to [[Governor of Florida|Governor]] [[Rick Scott]] to sign into law. The measure also prohibits [[bump stock]]s, and creates a program for the arming of some teachers. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/florida-legislature-sends-gun-school-safety-bill-governor-n854701 (NBC News)]

;Science and technology
*[[Observational astronomy]]
**[[European Space Agency|European astronomers]] [[Scientific method|observe]] the "[[Cosmogony|birth]]" of a [[Symbiotic binary|symbiotic X-ray binary]], [[IGR J17329-2731]], described as a [[Transient state|transient]], from the [[Galactic Center]] using [[INTEGRAL]] [[space telescope]]. [http://www.esa.int/Our_Activities/Space_Science/Donor_star_breathes_life_into_zombie_companion (European Space Agency)] [http://www.astronomerstelegram.org/?read=10645 ''(The Astronomer's Telegram'')]
*[[List of asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018|Asteroid close approaches to Earth in 2018]]
**[[Near-Earth object|Near-Earth]] [[asteroid]] {{mpl|2017 VR|12}} makes a flyby past [[Earth]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/2018/03/06/asteroid-could-big-empire-state-building-fly-past-earth-tonight-heres-how-see/401559002/ (''USA Today'')]
*[[Forensic anthropology]]
**[[Emeritus]] [[University of Tennessee]] Professor [[Richard Jantz]] claims that bones found in 1940 on [[Nikumaroro]], [[Kiribati]], almost certainly belong to [[List of missing aircraft|lost]] [[List of aviation pioneers|aviation pioneer]] [[Amelia Earhart]]. [http://www.newshub.co.nz/home/world/2018/03/expert-says-bones-found-in-1940-belong-to-amelia-earhart.html (''Newshub'')]
